name: Global Semantic Coherence Analysis
description: Measures the logical progression and decay of high-dimensional topic vectors across paragraphs to detect semantic drifting and 'hallucination of logic'.
mechanism: While superficially related to local cohesion, coherence evaluates the underlying deep semantic meaning and logical topic progression spanning an entire document. This algorithm transforms sequential sentences and paragraphs into high-dimensional vector embeddings and mathematically calculates the cosine similarity trajectory across the text. Authentic human writing naturally orbits a central thematic anchor, allowing for intentional, creative tangents before predictably returning to the core thesis. Conversely, unconstrained AI generation—especially when stretched across long context windows—suffers from severe 'topic drift'. It exhibits a slow, continuous wandering in semantic space, chaining immediate ideas together but entirely failing to anchor back to the original premise. By plotting this multidimensional drift trajectory against baseline human cognitive topologies, this method definitively identifies text generated without a persistent, centralized mental model.
useCase: Identifying long-form AI generation (such as automatically generated eBooks, essays, or long articles) that 'sounds right' paragraph-by-paragraph but gradually entirely loses the plot on a macro scale.
strengths:
• Directly attacks the fundamental, architectural weakness of attention-based transformers operating over extended context windows.
• Utilizes state-of-the-art embedding models to evaluate true abstract meaning and logical flow rather than relying on easily bypassed surface-level word choice.
• Ruthlessly exposes the 'rambling' and mathematically directionless nature of unconstrained LLM outputs.
limitations:
• Completely ineffective and fundamentally broken when applied to short texts (e.g., tweets, blurbs) where measurable semantic drift cannot geometrically accumulate.
• Extremely memory-and-compute intensive due to the requirement of continuous high-dimensional embedding extraction.
• Can trigger false positives on human 'stream-of-consciousness' writing, avant-garde literature, or highly disorganized brainstorming notes that produce identical drifting trajectories.
parameters:
Analysis: High-dimensional Embedding Cosine Trajectory
Metric: Mathematical Semantic Drift Rate vs. Thematic Anchoring
Output: 0-100 Coherence Decay (Semantic Drift) Score
accuracy: High — 80-88% strictly on texts exceeding 1000 words. Crucial and highly specialized for long-form macro-content verification.
